## Extracted

From the `.vmod` zip `images/` folder only (no Java / VASSAL automation):

| Path | Origin |
| --- | --- |
| `board/TS Map-11.jpg` | `images/TS Map-11.jpg` (installed via `scripts/install_vassal_ui_assets.py --fetch-board` if not present) |
| `cards/TNRnTS-NN.svg` | `images/TNRnTS-NN.svg` (NN = card number 01–110) |
| `markers/` | selected influence / UI SVGs from `images/` |

Card number `NN` matches the printed card number used by `src/struggler/data/cards.json`.
